description: Reverie full validation as a dagrun DAG (one node per gate; selected with --labels full). Authored 2026-11-05 from measured per-node wall/CPU/RSS at 83cff0aa; dagrun's profile feedback refines widths and memory caps from recorded runs.

steps.description: Runs scripts/check-skill-discovery.rs, the same check the serial validate.sh ran first.
steps.cmd: ./scripts/check-skill-discovery.rs

steps.description: Runs scripts/check-oss-cargo-twins.sh: its self-test, then the check that every oss_cargo/<crate>/Cargo.toml.oss has the bytes and mode of <crate>/Cargo.toml.
steps.cmd: ./scripts/check-oss-cargo-twins.sh --self-test && ./scripts/check-oss-cargo-twins.sh

steps.desc: Detcore allocation recipe generator round trip
steps.description: Runs scripts/detcore-alloc-recipe.py --self-test on reverie-liteinst-artifact/src/lib.rs, no ELF and no build. Every 241-byte fixed_patch_alloc row must be in the generator's canonical form. A row without the generated-row marker must be one of the pinned legacy rows (body and structure digest), each present once. Every row generated from a real ELF must agree with its own provenance comment: the recorded body SHA256, the recorded INSTALLATION_DEPTH cell against the encoded TLS read, and the operands and transfers of the cited masked-equal row, with the selecting GOT callee recorded whenever that digest has several structures. Controls that must be refused: hand edits of the encoded cell, an operand displacement, the recorded digest or the selecting callee; a stripped marker; a new unmarked row; a dropped legacy row; and, on a synthetic ELF built from each generated row, any GOT operand bound to another callee, including when it is the only masked-equal structure. Data and PLT operands are left to full qualification, and the node does not re-derive a row from its original image; that comparison is the review's.
steps.cmd: python3 -I -B scripts/detcore-alloc-recipe.py --self-test --lib reverie-liteinst-artifact/src/lib.rs

steps.description: cargo fmt --all -- --check over the whole workspace.
steps.cmd: cargo fmt --all -- --check

steps.description: Builds every workspace test binary once (--features "$STABLE_FEATURES", sourced from scripts/stable-features.sh; the stable set 1282 pins, same as validate.sh's serial path) and records nextest binaries-metadata plus the full test list under target/validate/. Every test node runs from this metadata, so no test node rebuilds and feature unification is the workspace's. This replaces the serial driver's separate `cargo build --workspace --features "$STABLE_FEATURES"` gate: measured 2026-11-05, all 274 artifact identities of that build are compiled by the test build (420 identities), and lint.clippy --all-targets additionally compiles the non-test lib profile, so dropping the duplicate build loses no compile coverage. Memory: a cold width-16 build OOM-killed at a 16 GB cap (peak 16.0 GB, 6 oom_kills, 2026-11-05); width 12 with a 24 GB baseline / 48 GB hard cap follows dagrun's size-above-recorded-peak rule.
steps.cmd: source scripts/stable-features.sh && mkdir -p target/validate && cargo nextest list --workspace --features "$STABLE_FEATURES" --list-type binaries-only --message-format json > target/validate/binaries-metadata.json && cargo nextest list --binaries-metadata target/validate/binaries-metadata.json --message-format json --list-type full > target/validate/list-full.json

steps.description: Compile reverie-liteinst in the exact no-default-features native-exec configuration Hermit uses, plus its liteinst-on pair. The workspace stable-feature build cannot catch this combination because workspace defaults unify the liteinst feature on.
steps.cmd: cargo check --locked -p reverie-liteinst --no-default-features --features exec-native-injection && cargo check --locked -p reverie-liteinst --no-default-features --features exec-native-injection,liteinst

steps.description: Compile only the reverie-ptrace library for aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu. Host validation exercises the package for the host architecture, so this separate package-scoped check catches target_arch conditional-compilation errors in library code. It intentionally does not compile test targets.
steps.cmd: cargo check --locked -p reverie-ptrace --lib --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu

steps.description: Runs scripts/check-liteinst-aarch64-l0.py (G2-G6): exact liteinst alias and lazy_promote reference checks; gnu check and musl build for every L0 feature set; named exec-private compile refusals; aarch64 clippy; and pinned qemu-aarch64 lib runs. Verified host tooling is devbig030 (declared gnu/musl std targets, rust-lld, /opt/fb-qemu-user/bin/qemu-aarch64). The script fails rather than skips when any prerequisite is missing. Its qemu leg runs the aarch64 lib tests serialized (--test-threads 1, required under qemu-user) and is intentionally not counted by libtest-counts; a counted test.* node can come later. G7 native preload/lazy_promote evidence is intentionally metal-only and is not in this DAG step.
steps.cmd: ./scripts/check-liteinst-aarch64-l0.py

steps.description: Runs the standalone allocator-fixture producer, which explicitly builds the leaf with --profile release and refuses a dev-profile body as outside the contract. It writes fixture.env under target/validate/liteinst-fixtures/bundle for the LiteInst A test node; test nodes already depend on this node, and it runs concurrently with build.test_binaries.
steps.cmd: rm -rf target/validate/liteinst-fixtures && mkdir -p target/validate && ./scripts/build-liteinst-test-runtime.rs --for-ci "$PWD/target/validate/liteinst-fixtures"

steps.description: Counted nextest over reverie-liteinst binaries strace, generic_bootstrap, standalone_constructor, tool_tls, fixed_arena, the lib tests, and the zero-case guest binaries. Binary lists in the two LiteInst nodes partition the package; validate.sh refuses if node totals drift from the workspace list.
steps.cmd: source target/validate/liteinst-fixtures/bundle/fixture.env && ./scripts/libtest-counts.rs run-nextest target/validate/counts-test-liteinst_a.json -- cargo nextest run --binaries-metadata target/validate/binaries-metadata.json -E "(package(reverie-liteinst) & (binary(=strace) | binary(=generic_bootstrap) | binary(=standalone_constructor) | binary(=tool_tls) | binary(=fixed_arena) | binary(=reverie_liteinst) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-trap-count-guest) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-strace) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-spoof-guest) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-rpc-tool-guest) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-lifecycle-guest))) & $REVERIE_NEXTEST_SKIP_FILTER"

steps.description: Counted nextest over the remaining reverie-liteinst binaries (allocator, mapping, region, rpc_tool, lifecycle and guest controls).
steps.cmd: ./scripts/libtest-counts.rs run-nextest target/validate/counts-test-liteinst_b.json -- cargo nextest run --binaries-metadata target/validate/binaries-metadata.json -E "(package(reverie-liteinst) & (binary(=native_unpublished) | binary(=allocator_contract) | binary(=region_stacks) | binary(=mapping_integrity) | binary(=lifecycle) | binary(=rpc_tool) | binary(=fixed_gates) | binary(=private_prepare) | binary(=grouped_admission) | binary(=concurrent_patching) | binary(=nop_window) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-fork-guest) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-exec-guest) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-allocator-private-control) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-allocator-install-control) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-allocator-host-control))) & $REVERIE_NEXTEST_SKIP_FILTER"

steps.description: Counted nextest over reverie-liteinst-artifact and reverie-liteinst-preload.
steps.cmd: ./scripts/libtest-counts.rs run-nextest target/validate/counts-test-liteinst_artifact.json -- cargo nextest run --binaries-metadata target/validate/binaries-metadata.json -E "(package(reverie-liteinst-artifact) | package(reverie-liteinst-preload)) & $REVERIE_NEXTEST_SKIP_FILTER"

steps.description: Counted nextest over reverie-ptrace, including the gdbstub suites.
steps.cmd: ./scripts/libtest-counts.rs run-nextest target/validate/counts-test-ptrace.json -- cargo nextest run --binaries-metadata target/validate/binaries-metadata.json -E "(package(reverie-ptrace) & not binary(=launch_descriptor_window)) & $REVERIE_NEXTEST_SKIP_FILTER"

steps.description: Counted nextest over the launch_descriptor_window binary alone, at low width. These tests race two tracer launches against a held transient descriptor and a sub-second overlap window (they already self-serialize in-process via a SERIAL mutex); under full-DAG load at width 32 the window closed before the launch waited, failing EMFILE (measured 2026-11-05, load 65-157). Isolating the binary at width 4 keeps its sibling launches from starving the window; the tests themselves stay parallel-unsafe by design and are named here rather than serialized silently. Scheduled after test.liteinst_a (the heaviest CPU node): these tests measure sub-second launch/trap timing windows that full-DAG CPU burst contention closes (measured 2026-11-05: PASS in isolation at width 16/4, EMFILE/SIGSYS-miss under concurrent cold/warm DAG load). Width 1: the binary serializes itself in-process (SERIAL mutex + process-wide descriptor fills); parallel processes of it still starve each other's launch-overlap window (EMFILE at width 4 under full-DAG load). Runs last (after test.inguest): even at width 1 in the quiet tail it EMFILE-failed under concurrent full-DAG load (host load 73-157); with every other test node finished, only foreign host load remains.
steps.cmd: ./scripts/libtest-counts.rs run-nextest target/validate/counts-test-ptrace_launch.json -- cargo nextest run --binaries-metadata target/validate/binaries-metadata.json -E "(package(reverie-ptrace) & binary(=launch_descriptor_window)) & $REVERIE_NEXTEST_SKIP_FILTER"

steps.description: Counted nextest over reverie-kvm and reverie-kvm-core.
steps.cmd: ./scripts/libtest-counts.rs run-nextest target/validate/counts-test-kvm.json -- cargo nextest run --binaries-metadata target/validate/binaries-metadata.json -E "(package(reverie-kvm) | package(reverie-kvm-core)) & $REVERIE_NEXTEST_SKIP_FILTER"

steps.description: Counted nextest over reverie-linuxemu and reverie-examples.
steps.cmd: ./scripts/libtest-counts.rs run-nextest target/validate/counts-test-emu.json -- cargo nextest run --binaries-metadata target/validate/binaries-metadata.json -E "(package(reverie-linuxemu) | package(reverie-examples)) & $REVERIE_NEXTEST_SKIP_FILTER"

steps.description: Counted nextest over reverie-inguest. Width is lower: bounded-recipe tests compile payloads at runtime, so each test process fans out further. Scheduled after test.liteinst_a (the heaviest CPU node): these tests measure sub-second launch/trap timing windows that full-DAG CPU burst contention closes (measured 2026-11-05: PASS in isolation at width 16/4, EMFILE/SIGSYS-miss under concurrent cold/warm DAG load). Also after test.ptrace (the longest node): the smoke spoof-getpid trap-arming race still fired with only the LiteInst burst removed. The node first rebuilds reverie-inguest with its STABLE_FEATURES subset (derived from scripts/stable-features.sh, preload-constructor included) under the cargo-build resource: deps/libreverie_inguest.so is an unhashed filename shared by every build graph, and reverie-liteinst depends on reverie-inguest with default-features=false (no preload-constructor), so a concurrent cargo build can overwrite the constructor-ful cdylib the smoke tests LD_PRELOAD (measured 2026-11-05: spoof-getpid inert until rebuilt). Holding cargo-build for the whole node makes the rebuild the last writer before the tests run.
steps.cmd: . scripts/stable-features.sh && feats=""; for f in $STABLE_FEATURES; do case $f in reverie-inguest/*) feats="$feats $f";; esac; done; cargo build -p reverie-inguest --features "$feats" && ./scripts/libtest-counts.rs run-nextest target/validate/counts-test-inguest.json -- cargo nextest run --binaries-metadata target/validate/binaries-metadata.json -E "(package(reverie-inguest)) & $REVERIE_NEXTEST_SKIP_FILTER"

steps.description: Counted nextest over the remaining workspace packages (core, safeptrace, rpc-transport, process, loader, memory, syscalls, test-support, util, and the zero-test experimental packages, whose listings keep the node totals exact).
steps.cmd: ./scripts/libtest-counts.rs run-nextest target/validate/counts-test-core.json -- cargo nextest run --binaries-metadata target/validate/binaries-metadata.json -E "(package(safeptrace) | package(reverie-core) | package(reverie-rpc-transport) | package(reverie-process) | package(reverie-loader) | package(reverie-test-support) | package(reverie-syscalls) | package(reverie-memory) | package(reverie-util) | package(nostd-print) | package(reverie-linux-provider) | package(reverie-rpc) | package(riptrace-rpc)) & $REVERIE_NEXTEST_SKIP_FILTER"

steps.description: Counted doctests via the serial libtest runner (nextest does not run doctests): cargo test --workspace --doc --features "$STABLE_FEATURES" with per-test CPU caps. The stable set (scripts/stable-features.sh, as in validate.sh's serial test step) is required: doctests of feature-gated modules, such as the reverie-inguest exec-stop producer's ArmedClaim borrow guard (a compile_fail doctest), are not compiled without it.
steps.cmd: source scripts/stable-features.sh && ./scripts/libtest-counts.rs run target/validate/counts-doc.json -- cargo test --workspace --doc --features "$STABLE_FEATURES"

steps.description: reverie-examples/e2e/run.sh: every backend this host has, judged against the ledger for its environment (report-only without one).
steps.cmd: ./reverie-examples/e2e/run.sh

steps.description: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features "$STABLE_FEATURES" -- -D warnings (stable set from scripts/stable-features.sh, same as validate.sh's serial path). Also the compile-coverage backstop for the non-test lib profile now that the duplicate cargo build gate is gone.
steps.cmd: source scripts/stable-features.sh && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features "$STABLE_FEATURES" -- -D warnings
